info.title: Emisell Partner API
info.description: Public contract for the backend of an approved Emisell app. Only paths in this document are callable Partner API operations. Developer Dashboard routes and Payment/Shipping execution contracts are intentionally excluded. Scopes and webhook events marked planned reserve names for future integrations and do not claim that an endpoint or event producer is live.

tags.name: Products
tags.description: Implemented product pilot, disabled by default; not general availability

tags.name: Extension catalog
tags.description: Category, capability and surface discovery; no authorization side effects.

get.description: Returns the authoritative scope registry. A provider may configure only registered scope names. Only entries with availability=available have a callable resource endpoint.
Returns the persisted event catalog. Only availability=available events can be selected when configuring a webhook subscription.

post.summary: Exchange an authorization code for an installation token
post.description: Uses HTTP Basic client authentication and PKCE. The code is single-use and the exact redirect URI must match the authorization request.

400.description: Malformed, expired, consumed, or PKCE-invalid grant

get.description: Validates the opaque installation token and resolves the app, Emisell merchant, installed version, environment, and current effective scopes. The provider never supplies merchantId as a request parameter.
Requires the read_merchant scope. The profile is derived from the authenticated installation, never from a provider-controlled merchant ID header or query parameter.

get.summary: List products for the signed merchant tenant
get.description: Operator-enabled read_products pilot, disabled by default. Authenticate using an installation token from /oauth/token. Merchant comes exclusively from the verified installation; do not send merchantId, merchant_id, store_id or environment selectors. Unknown/duplicate query parameters are rejected. Public scope availability remains planned until rollout review; do not publish apps depending on this scope. Lists base product fields only; no variants or product webhooks. updatedAfter accepts UTC Z timestamps with up to three fractional digits. Cursor is tied to installation and unchanged filters; concurrent edits are not snapshot-isolated.

get.summary: Get one product for the signed merchant tenant
get.description: Operator-enabled read_products pilot, disabled by default. Authenticate using an installation token from /oauth/token. Merchant comes exclusively from the verified installation; do not send merchantId, merchant_id, store_id or environment selectors. Unknown/duplicate query parameters are rejected. Public scope availability remains planned until rollout review; do not publish apps depending on this scope. Cross-tenant products return 404.

get.summary: Read paid-feature entitlement for the current installation
get.description: Default off: APP_BILLING_ENABLED=false; live fees also require APP_BILLING_LIVE_ENABLED=true in production. Gated implementation, not an activated payment workflow. See docs/app-billing.md. Installation bearer token only, lifecycle rechecked. No identity selectors, cookies or Origin. This endpoint does not grant additional resource scopes and does not itself enforce features inside an external developer app.

200.description: Read paid-feature entitlement for the current installation

503.description: Billing module disabled; app_billing_disabled. Do not fall back to paid access or zero app fees when billing is expected.

get.summary: Read app categories, extension families, capabilities, surfaces and draft runtime policy
get.description: Public, non-tenant metadata from the reviewed Go registry. Category is discovery metadata; family describes configuration; capability status describes contracts. The generic v1 external-provider runtime remains a disabled draft. shipping.rates.calculate is a default-off internal API Kurir pilot and is not a Partner API endpoint. Reading/selecting capabilities never grants scopes or activates execution. Existing payment/shipping/custom wire types and listing categories are unchanged. No merchant data, credentials or internal runtime URLs. Cache-Control: no-store.

200.description: Catalog metadata, not installation readiness or authorization.

capabilities.name: Read merchant identity
capabilities.description: Backend app membaca identitas merchant dari installation token.
limitations: Tetap memerlukan installation token aktif dan merchant consent; tidak memberi akses seluruh profil/customer.

capabilities.name: Read base products
capabilities.description: Pilot produk dasar, default-off. Bukan variant, inventory siap jual, atau checkout.
limitations: Aktivasi operator dan merchant allowlist diperlukan; read_products tetap planned untuk publikasi.

capabilities.name: Calculate shipping rates
capabilities.description: Bridge internal App Platform ke API Kurir sudah diimplementasikan tetapi nonaktif secara default. API Kurir menghitung dari rate card, snapshot/cache, atau optional provider quote pada miss/stale.
limitations: Capability ini opsional dan tidak memaksa hit RajaOngkir/provider. API Kurir tetap memiliki quota ledger, credential, provider selection, location mapping dan cache policy.
Hanya Emisell Backend tepercaya yang dapat memanggil bridge; endpoint tidak menjadi Partner API developer.

capabilities.name: Create shipment
capabilities.description: Pembuatan pengiriman terpisah dari permintaan ongkir.
limitations: Belum ada kontrak execution App Platform; quote ongkir tidak boleh digunakan sebagai jaminan booking.
Capability ID bukan OAuth scope. Otorisasi execution belum ditetapkan; jangan memintanya pada consent.

capabilities.name: Track shipment
limitations: Belum ada dispatch/tracking webhook App Platform.
Capability ID bukan OAuth scope. Otorisasi execution belum ditetapkan; jangan memintanya pada consent.

capabilities.name: Start payment
capabilities.description: Memulai pembayaran membutuhkan kontrak transaksi khusus.
limitations: Scope resource order tidak memberi izin charge/capture; kontrak dan approval payment belum tersedia.
Capability ID bukan OAuth scope. Otorisasi execution belum ditetapkan; jangan memintanya pada consent.

capabilities.name: Refund payment
capabilities.description: Refund adalah operasi terpisah dengan persetujuan dan idempotency sendiri.
limitations: Belum tersedia; tidak diaktifkan oleh kategori Payment atau status app aktif.
Capability ID bukan OAuth scope. Otorisasi execution belum ditetapkan; jangan memintanya pada consent.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Short-lived Bearer runtime JWT issued by App Platform for one operation and one installation-extension binding.

headers.name: X-Emisell-Invocation-Id
headers.description: Unique invocation identifier generated by App Platform and echoed by the provider.

headers.name: X-Emisell-Idempotency-Key
headers.description: Required only by mutation operation policy. Rate calculation deduplication and provider quota control remain inside API Kurir.

headers.name: X-Emisell-Deadline
headers.description: Absolute RFC3339 deadline. Provider must stop work after it expires.

operations.description: Ask API Kurir to resolve rates for one validated checkout request. API Kurir checks local rate cards and exact snapshots/cache before an optional provider quote, so one calculation does not imply one upstream hit.
Create one shipment after Emisell business validation; the provider result is not the source of truth for order state.
Read normalized tracking for an existing provider shipment reference.
Initialize a provider payment session while Emisell retains transaction ownership.
Process an approved payment action without accepting merchant or amount overrides from the provider.
Cancel a provider payment session using the same installation and transaction binding.
Request a refund against an Emisell-authorized amount and transaction reference.

invariants: Merchant, installation, extension, installed version, environment and operation are derived by trusted services; providers cannot select another tenant.
The dispatcher resolves only the reviewed runtime URL from the installed immutable snapshot and applies destination policy before network access.
A valid token still requires active app, installation and extension state at dispatch time; uninstall or suspension fails closed.
No automatic retry is allowed in v1. A caller may repeat only with the same idempotency key after checking the recorded result.
Payment and shipping business state remains owned by Emisell Backend; provider responses are validated inputs, not authoritative state transitions.
Rate calculation is optional per shipping extension. API Kurir owns cache, request coalescing, provider quota and fallback; App Platform never forces one RajaOngkir hit per checkout.

clientBasic.description: Sandbox or production client ID and client secret. Secrets must remain server-side.

installationBearer.description: Opaque es_at_ installation token returned by /oauth/token.

scopes.read_products: Base products — operator-enabled pilot only, public availability planned

InvalidInstallationToken.description: The installation token is missing, invalid, expired, revoked, or bound to an inactive installation

InsufficientScope.description: The effective installation grants do not contain the required scope

ResourceUnauthorized.description: The provider installation token is missing, invalid, expired or revoked. Internal service assertion failures instead return 503 resource_unavailable.

ResourceForbidden.description: The active installation token lacks read_products or installation access is forbidden.

ResourceNotFound.description: The resource does not exist within the signed merchant tenant.

ResourceRateLimited.description: The app, installation, merchant, or route limit was exceeded.

ResourceUnavailable.description: 503 resource_disabled: gateway pilot is off. 503 resource_unavailable: backend disabled, unreachable, invalid service configuration, merchant missing/inactive/suspended, timeout or invalid upstream response. No upstream error body is exposed; ask the operator to correlate requestId before retrying policy failures.

EmisellMerchantId.description: Opaque stable Merchant.id owned by Emisell. Do not parse or generate it.

availability.description: Only available scopes have callable provider endpoints.

access_token.description: Returned once. Store only in a server-side secret store.

sku.description: Base Product.sku, not a variant SKU. May be empty.

description.description: Source description may contain untrusted HTML. Escape or sanitize before rendering.

price.description: Raw base Product.price as a decimal string (trailing zeros are not guaranteed). Not the cheapest variant or storefront display price; no tax calculation or currency conversion. Currency is not returned in this slice; do not infer it or use this as a checkout price.

compareAtPrice.description: Raw nullable base Product.compareAtPrice, not a variant compare-at price. Decimal string with no currency conversion.

stock.description: Raw nullable Product.stock. Not stock minus soldCount, variant stock, reservations or available-to-sell. Inventory API is planned.

status.description: Source-of-truth product status. Consumers must tolerate new values.

nextCursor.description: Opaque cursor for the next page, or null when this is the final page.

amountMinor.description: Integer minor units: IDR whole rupiah; USD cents. Excludes invoice tax. No currency conversion.

interval.description: free requires amountMinor=0; monthly requires amountMinor>0.

approvedBy.description: Authenticated merchant user; redacted to an empty string in provider responses.

paidAccess.description: Rechecked using installation/org lifecycle and paidThrough. Status active alone is insufficient. Provider must check this before granting paid features; this is not a new resource scope.

test.description: true means development test records. Never forward these charges to a live payment provider.

configurationSupported.description: Only configuration/snapshots are supported; this is not operational readiness.

executionEnabled.description: General runtime availability, not caller authorization. False for planned/default-off pilot. Never overrides consent, lifecycle or deployment policy.
The generic external-provider dispatcher is not activated. The specialized API Kurir rate bridge is a separately gated internal pilot.

ResourceLimit.name: limit
ResourceLimit.description: Maximum number of products to return.

ResourceCursor.name: cursor
ResourceCursor.description: HMAC-signed opaque cursor returned by the previous page, bound to merchant, installation, environment and filters. Clients must not create or parse it. Changing cursor keys invalidates existing cursors.

ResourceUpdatedAfter.name: updatedAfter
ResourceUpdatedAfter.description: Return products updated strictly after this UTC timestamp (Z suffix, up to three fractional digits). Use the same filters when continuing a cursor; pagination is not a snapshot of concurrent edits.
